requests.purpose: Pin current boot before icon metadata sampling
Bounded ten adaptive/fallback candidates: discover exact code/resource files and pin existing side-written icon SHA/metadata; missing fields remain unknown
argv:
for p in com.kaajjo.libresudoku com.lcdcode.moodcairns com.paperknifeplus.app com.groce.app org.fossify.calendar org.tasks eu.dfdx.jslab app.varlorg.unote com.alxgnon.postwriter com.fsck.k9; do d=/data/app/el1/bundle/public/$p; printf '
PACKAGE=%s
' "$p"; ls -ldZ "$d" "$d/android"; ls -lZ "$d/android"; f="$d/android/icon.png"; if [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ]; then stat -c '%u:%g %a %s %d:%i' "$f"; sha256sum "$f"; fi; done; printf '
REMOTE_RC=%s
' "$?"
requests.note: Outer must preserve each command's error/absence, not treat final REMOTE_RC alone as proof every requested path exists.
